thread:
anna: Quick sync — prepping AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings for the new Private offering. Need clarity on VPC/KMS requirements + final branding assets. Who owns KMS policy and alias rotation for the marketplace bundles? Also product needs SKU + trial limits for packaging.

sam: Cloud ops here. Short answer: Hosted/Dedicated = Redwood-managed KMS; Private = BYOK (customer-managed). For marketplace listings we should offer both variants. If BYOK is selected we need a key policy that permits our marketplace role to encrypt/decrypt.

matt: Legal — we can draft the marketplace-specific clauses. BYOK has different liabilities; I'll add recommended warranty language. Also need to confirm data residency text for EU marketplace entries.

jia: Product notes — proposed SKU names: `redwood-inference-hosted`, `redwood-inference-dedicated`, `redwood-inference-private`. Trial proposal: hosted = 14 days, dedicated = 30 days (limited throughput), private = no free trial (sales-assisted eval). Need final wording for short description (150 chars), bullets, and 1024x1024 PNG + hero image. Where should teams upload assets?

anna: Upload to the marketplace bucket: https://storage.redwood.com/marketplace/branding/ I'll create the folder `private-offering/`. Branding checklist: 1024x1024 PNG (transparent ok), hero 1600x600 JPG, README.md with 150-char short desc + 3 bullet lines.

sam: Example minimal AWS KMS key policy we recommend for BYOK (customer to include Redwood principal):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-marketplace"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

sam: Also adding a short Terraform snippet for the listing that shows KMS attachment + VPC endpoints (for ops docs):

```
resource "aws_kms_key" "customer" {
  description = "Customer BYOK for Redwood Marketplace"
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
}
```

jia: Metering/entitlement: AWS -> metered per-token usage; GCP/Azure -> mapped to credit-based SKUs for trial. I'll prepare a mapping spreadsheet and SKU-to-entitlement table by Monday.

nishit: Sales heads up — Azure requires MPN verification and publisher ID; we can queue marketplace enrollment once legal signs off. Also confirm pricing models so sales can quote during trials.

matt: I'll produce a short pack: required marketplace clauses (refunds, data handling, indemnity) + a GDPR/data residency blurb for EU listings. Expect a draft by Wednesday EOD.

deploy-bot: Created ticket MKP-321: `marketplace-private-listing-prep` assigned to partnerships, cloud-ops, product. (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKP-321)
